question: Functions $f,g:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$ are defined by $f(x)=x+2$ and $g(x)=3x$. If $(g\circ f)(x)=21$, find $x$. Also find $(f\circ g)(x)$ for this value of $x$.
explanation:
Formation of $g\circ f$
$$(g\circ f)(x)=g(x+2)=3(x+2)=3x+6.$$

Determination of $x$
Given $(g\circ f)(x)=21$,
$$3x+6=21.$$
Therefore,
$$3x=15\Rightarrow x=5.$$

Evaluation of $f\circ g$
$$(f\circ g)(x)=f(3x)=3x+2.$$
Therefore, at $x=5$,
$$(f\circ g)(5)=3(5)+2=17.$$

Final result
Hence, $x=5$ and $(f\circ g)(5)=17$.
